name: qt-cmake
inputs: A project-owned CMake source directory and explicit isolated build/report paths
Resolved CMake/CTest tools, project definitions and an independently maintained required-test list
outputs: Configured and built project files in the declared build directory
One command record, stdout/stderr and CTest JUnit evidence per explicit invocation
support: Project-parameterized CMake/CTest bridge, including Qt projects. SDK selection, target expectations and actual sandbox permissions belong to the project/host; no installer, scheduler or acceptance authority.
